change_summary: Keep host-local output authority separate from Corvio durable-write authority, and recognize exact canonical Asset reuse from bounded inventory receipts.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.6 clarifies that a read-only host output surface does not disable an otherwise authorized Corvio durable result.

server_contract.note: The unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract now presents the same independent host-local and Corvio-write authority boundary in server-delivered guidance.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.6 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.6.

package_setup.note: OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host harness now treats a bounded list_files inventory as canonical exact-byte reuse evidence and keeps local-output authority distinct from Corvio durability.

external_marketplaces.note: Anthropic, WorkBuddy, and other account-owned listing or fresh-host acceptance remains pending until external receipts exist.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers bounded canonical Asset inventory parsing plus fresh Codex and Claude attachment-update reruns against the live MCP.
